title: What is the United Nations Security Council?
speaker: Tom Wilkinson

keywords.def: A formal decision or statement made by an organisation or group.
The act of getting involved in a situation to change what happens.
Lasting for a long time or forever.
The power to reject or block a decision or proposal.
The state of being safe or protected from danger.
The act of speaking or acting on behalf of others.

sentences.en: In recent weeks the United Nations Security Council has met to discuss Israel’s planned military expansion in Gaza, to reject the creation of a rival government in Sudan, and hear reports of conflicts in Yemen, Syria, and at the Thailand/Cambodia border.
sentences.zh: 最近几周，联合国安理会召开会议，讨论了以色列在加沙的计划军事扩张行动，拒绝了苏丹建立对立政府的企图，并听取了关于也门、叙利亚以及泰国与柬埔寨边境冲突的报告。

sentences.en: The Security Council is a powerful, yet controversial, organisation at the centre of the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 安理会是联合国核心机构中一个强大却又备受争议的组织。

sentences.en: They have an immense amount of power, but this power is concentrated in the hands of just 5 countries.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有巨大的权力，但这权力却集中在仅仅5个国家的手中。

sentences.en: Today I want to think about 2 questions.
sentences.zh: 今天我想思考两个问题。

sentences.en: What exactly is the UN Security Council, and why does it have so much influence over international peace and security?
sentences.zh: 到底什么是联合国安理会，为什么它对国际和平与安全拥有如此大的影响力？

sentences.en: In today’s episode of Thinking in English, we’re going to look at the history of the Security Council, how it works, and the difference between permanent and temporary members.
sentences.zh: 在今天的Thinking in English节目中，我们将探讨安理会的历史、它的运作方式，以及常任理事国和非常任理事国的区别。

sentences.en: We’ll talk about its goals and powers, examine some of the criticisms it faces, and think about what the future might hold for one of the most powerful organisations in the world.
sentences.zh: 我们将谈论它的目标和权力，审视它面临的一些批评，并思考这个世界上最强大的组织之一未来将会如何。

sentences.en: The United Nations Security Council, often called the Security Council, is one of the most important parts of the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 联合国安全理事会，通常被称为安理会，是联合国最重要的组成部分之一。

sentences.en: While the UN has many different bodies and organisations, the Security Council is the one responsible for keeping international peace and security.
sentences.zh: 虽然联合国拥有许多不同的机构和组织，但安理会是那个负责维持国际和平与安全的机构。

sentences.en: Its main responsibilities include: trying to prevent wars and violent conflicts between countries; authorising military action if it believes it is necessary to protect peace; imposing sanctions, punishments like trade restrictions, on countries that break international rules; and approving and organising peacekeeping missions, where UN soldiers are sent to conflict areas to protect civilians and help maintain order.
sentences.zh: 它的主要职责包括：努力防止国家之间的战争和暴力冲突；在认为必要以维护和平时授权采取军事行动；对违反国际规则的国家实施制裁，即贸易限制等惩罚；以及批准和组织维和任务，派遣联合国士兵前往冲突地区保护平民并帮助维持秩序。

sentences.en: The Security Council has a special kind of power under the UN Charter which is the main legal document that explains how the UN works.
sentences.zh: 根据《联合国宪章》（即阐述联合国运作方式的主要法律文件），安理会拥有一种特殊的权力。

sentences.en: This means that when the Security Council makes a decision, it is binding.
sentences.zh: 这意味着当安理会做出决定时，它是具有约束力的。

sentences.en: In other words, all UN member countries are legally required to follow it.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，所有联合国成员国在法律上都必须遵守它。

sentences.en: The UN Security Council was created in 1945, at the same time as the United Nations itself.
sentences.zh: 联合国安理会创建于1945年，与联合国本身的成立时间相同。

sentences.en: World leaders had just experienced the horrors of World War II, and they wanted to design a system that could prevent another global conflict.
sentences.zh: 世界各国领导人刚刚经历第二次世界大战的恐怖，他们希望设计一个能够防止另一场全球冲突的系统。

sentences.en: At a meeting in San Francisco, representatives from 50 countries agreed on the UN Charter, the set of rules for how the organisation would work.
sentences.zh: 在旧金山的一次会议上，来自50个国家的代表就《联合国宪章》达成一致，这是一套关于该组织如何运作的规则。

sentences.en: One of the main ideas was collective security.
sentences.zh: 其中一个核心理念就是集体安全。

sentences.en: Collective security is the belief that all countries should work together to stop aggression and protect peace.
sentences.zh: 集体安全是指这样一种信念：所有国家应当共同努力来制止侵略并保护和平。

sentences.en: The world would be more secure if countries had a place to meet, discuss, and negotiate with each other and in the presence of other countries.
sentences.zh: 如果各国能够有一个地方相聚、讨论并彼此谈判，并且有其他国家在场，世界将会更加安全。

sentences.en: The structure of the Security Council reflected the political reality of 1945.
sentences.zh: 安理会的结构反映了1945年的政治现实。

sentences.en: The most powerful countries from the winning side of World War II, China (at the time represented by the Republic of China which moved to Taiwan after the civil war, but was eventually replaced by the People’s Republic of China at the UN), France, the Soviet Union (now represented by Russia), the United Kingdom, and the United States,§ were given permanent seats and special powers.
sentences.zh: 来自二战胜利一方的最强大国家：中国（当时由内战后撤往台湾的中华民国代表，但最终在联合国被中华人民共和国取代）、法国、苏联（现由俄罗斯代表）、英国和美国，被赋予了常任理事国席位和特殊权力。§

sentences.en: The other seats would be filled by countries chosen for shorter terms, allowing more nations to participate in decisions about peace and security.
sentences.zh: 其他席位将由任期较短的国家填补，从而让更多的国家能够参与有关和平与安全的决策。

sentences.en: From its first meeting in January 1946, the Security Council has been at the centre of some of the world’s biggest political debates, crises, and peace efforts.
sentences.zh: 从1946年1月召开第一次会议以来，安理会一直处于全球一些最大政治辩论、危机和维和努力的中心。

sentences.en: The UN Security Council has 15 members in total.
sentences.zh: 联合国安理会总共有15个成员国。

sentences.en: These are divided into two groups: permanent members and temporary members.
sentences.zh: 它们分为两组：常任理事国和非常任理事国。

sentences.en: The five permanent members, often called the P5, are China, France, Russia, the United Kingdom, and the United States These countries have been permanent members since the Security Council was created in 1945.
sentences.zh: 五个常任理事国，通常被称为P5，分别是中国、法国、俄罗斯、英国和美国。这些国家自1945年安理会成立以来一直都是常任理事国。

sentences.en: They have a special power called the veto.
sentences.zh: 他们拥有一种被称为否决权的特殊权力。

sentences.en: This means that if just one permanent member votes “no” on a major decision, the whole resolution is blocked, even if every other country agrees.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，只要有一个常任理事国对重大决定投“反对”票，整个决议就会被阻断，即使其他所有国家都赞同。

sentences.en: This gives the P5 a huge influence over the Council’s actions.
sentences.zh: 这使得P5对安理会的行动拥有巨大的影响力。

sentences.en: And can make it hard to come to an agreement on difficult situations, as often the US, Russia, and China will disagree with each other.
sentences.zh: 并且这可能导致在艰难局势上很难达成共识，因为美国、俄罗斯和中国往往会产生意见分歧。

sentences.en: The other ten members are temporary members.
sentences.zh: 另外十个成员国是非常任理事国。

sentences.en: They are chosen by the UN General Assembly, a meeting of all UN countries, for two-year terms.
sentences.zh: 它们由联合国大会（所有联合国成员国的会议）选举产生，任期两年。

sentences.en: Temporary members do not have veto power, but they can still vote, join discussions, and help shape the Council’s decisions.
sentences.zh: 非常任理事国没有否决权，但它们仍然可以投票、参与讨论，并帮助塑造安理会的决策。

sentences.en: Seats for temporary members are shared between different regions of the world, so that every part of the globe has a chance to be represented.
sentences.zh: 非常任理事国的席位在世界不同地区之间分配，以便全球各个角落都有机会获得代表权。

sentences.en: Right now, the ten non-permanent members of the security council are Algeria, Denmark, Greece, Guyana, Pakistan, Panama, South Korea, Sierra Leone, Slovenia, and Somalia.
sentences.zh: 目前，安理会的十个非常任理事国是阿尔及利亚、丹麦、希腊、圭亚那、巴基斯坦、巴拿马、韩国、塞拉利昂、斯洛文尼亚和索马里。

sentences.en: The main goal of the UN Security Council is simple: to keep the world safe and peaceful.
sentences.zh: 联合国安理会的主要目标很简单：保持世界的安全与和平。

sentences.en: But in practice, this can be a very difficult job.
sentences.zh: 但在实践中，这可能是一项非常艰难的工作。

sentences.en: One of the goals is to prevent armed conflict.
sentences.zh: 其中一个目标是防止武装冲突。

sentences.en: The Council tries to solve problems before they turn into wars, but this is much easier said than done.
sentences.zh: 安理会试图在问题演变成战争之前解决它们，但这说起来容易做起来难。

sentences.en: If fighting breaks out, the UN Security Council can respond to the crisis.
sentences.zh: 如果爆发战斗，联合国安理会就可以对危机作出反应。

sentences.en: Some of the things the Council can do is organise peace talks, send peacekeepers, or approve military action.
sentences.zh: 安理会能做的一些事情包括组织和平谈判、派遣维和人员或批准军事行动。

sentences.en: Once a conflict is over, the Security Council has the goal of supporting peach after conflict.
sentences.zh: 一旦冲突结束，安理会的目标就是支持战后和平。

sentences.en: The Council is supposed to help rebuild countries after war by supporting new governments, restoring order, and protecting civilians.
sentences.zh: 安理会理应通过支持新政府、恢复秩序和保护平民来帮助国家在战后重建。

sentences.en: Of course, all of these goals and tasks are incredibly difficult challenges, and the Security Council can take many different actions to achieve these goals.
sentences.zh: 当然，所有这些目标和任务都是极其艰难的挑战，安理会可以采取许多不同的行动来实现这些目标。

sentences.en: It might pass resolutions that demand countries stop fighting, impose sanctions that make it harder for aggressive governments to get money or weapons, or send UN peacekeeping forces to protect people in dangerous situations.
sentences.zh: 它可能会通过决议要求各国停止战斗，实施制裁使好战政府更难获得资金或武器，或者派遣联合国维和部队在危险情况下保护人民。

sentences.en: For example, after Iraq invaded Kuwait in 1990, the Security Council passed strong resolutions demanding withdrawal.
sentences.zh: 例如，在1990年伊拉克入侵科威特之后，安理会通过了强烈要求其撤军的决议。

sentences.en: It also authorised a coalition of countries to use military force to remove Iraqi forces.
sentences.zh: 它还授权一个国家联盟使用军事力量驱逐伊拉克军队。

sentences.en: The Council authorised military action to protect civilians during the civil war in Libya.
sentences.zh: 安理会曾授权采取军事行动在利比亚内战期间保护平民。

sentences.en: This decision was at first seen as a success for international intervention, but later turned out to be incredibly controversial.
sentences.zh: 这一决定最初被视为国际干预的成功，但后来却变得极具争议。

sentences.en: There are also a lot of criticisms surrounding the Security Council.
sentences.zh: 围绕安理会也存在着许多批评。

sentences.en: One major criticism is the veto power. This rule means that if even one permanent member votes “no” on a major decision, the action cannot go ahead.
sentences.zh: 一个主要的批评是否决权。这条规则意味着，哪怕只有一个常任理事国对一项重大决定投“反对”票，该行动就无法推进。

sentences.en: Countries have used the veto to protect their own interests, even in situations where urgent action was needed.
sentences.zh: 各国曾利用否决权来保护他们自己的利益，甚至在需要采取紧急行动的情况下也是如此。

sentences.en: This can make the Council slow and ineffective during crises.
sentences.zh: 这会使得安理会在危机期间变得迟缓且低效。

sentences.en: For example, after the Security Council approved action in Libya, Russia and China felt like they had been misled by the US.
sentences.zh: 例如，在安理会批准对利比亚采取行动后，俄罗斯和中国觉得他们被美国误导了。

sentences.en: In response, they have repeatedly vetoed any military interventions.
sentences.zh: 作为回应，他们多次对任何军事干预行使否决权。

sentences.en: For example, multiple resolutions addressing the civil war in Syria have been blocked by vetoes from Russia and China.
sentences.zh: 例如，多项旨在解决叙利亚内战的决议都被俄罗斯和中国的否决票所阻挠。

sentences.en: And when Russia invaded Ukraine, the Security Council tried to respond, but Russia’s veto prevented major resolutions against its actions.
sentences.zh: 而当俄罗斯入侵乌克兰时，安理会试图作出反应，但俄罗斯的否决权阻止了针对其行动的重大决议。

sentences.en: Another criticism is representation. The five permanent members were chosen in 1945, after World War II.
sentences.zh: 另一个批评是代表性问题。五个常任理事国是在1945年二战后选出的。

sentences.en: At that time, they were among the most powerful countries.
sentences.zh: 在那个时候，它们属于最强大的国家。

sentences.en: But the world has changed, and powers like India, Brazil, Japan, South Korea, and Germany play a much bigger role today, yet they do not have permanent seats.
sentences.zh: 但世界已经变了，像印度、巴西、日本、韩国和德国这样的力量在今天的扮演着重要得多的角色，然而它们却没有常任理事国席位。

sentences.en: Many people say the Council no longer reflects modern global politics.
sentences.zh: 许多人说安理会已经不再反映现代的全球政治。

sentences.en: The Council is also sometimes accused of double standards.
sentences.zh: 安理会有时也被指责存在双重标准。

sentences.en: Critics say it acts strongly in some situations but ignores others, depending on the political interests of the permanent members.
sentences.zh: 批评者称它在某些情况下行动强硬，但在其他情况下却选择忽视，这取决于常任理事国的政治利益。

sentences.en: For many years, world leaders and experts have been talking about how to reform the UN Security Council.
sentences.zh: 多年来，世界领导人和专家一直在讨论如何改革联合国安理会。

sentences.en: Most people agree that the way it works now has problems, but there is no agreement on how to fix them.
sentences.zh: 大多数人一致认为它目前的运作方式存在问题，但对于如何解决这些问题却没有达成共识。

sentences.en: One common idea is to add more permanent members.
sentences.zh: 一个常见的想法是增加常任理事国成员。

sentences.en: Countries like India, Brazil, Germany, and Japan, as well as representatives from Africa, are often suggested.
sentences.zh: 印度、巴西、德国和日本等国家，以及来自非洲的代表，经常被提名。

sentences.en: This could make the Council more representative of today’s world.
sentences.zh: 这可以使安理会更能代表当今的世界。

sentences.en: Even more radical would be to remove permanent members entirely (which is very unlikely).
sentences.zh: 更激进的做法是彻底取消常任理事国（这非常不可能）。

sentences.en: Another proposal is to limit the veto power, especially in situations involving genocide or other serious human rights violations.
sentences.zh: 另一个提案是限制否决权，特别是在涉及种族灭绝或其他严重侵犯人权行为的情况下。

sentences.en: Supporters say this would stop permanent members from blocking urgent action.
sentences.zh: 支持者表示，这将阻止常任理事国阻挠紧急行动。

sentences.en: Some suggest changing the way temporary seats are shared between regions, so that more voices are heard in discussions.
sentences.zh: 一些人建议改变非常任理事国在各地区之间的分配方式，以便在讨论中听到更多声音。

sentences.en: However, reform is extremely difficult. To change the rules, all five permanent members must agree, and they are often reluctant to give up any of their power.
sentences.zh: 然而，改革极其困难。要改变规则，所有五个常任理事国必须达成一致，而它们往往很不情愿放弃哪怕一点点权力。

sentences.en: For now, the Security Council will likely continue to work much as it does today.
sentences.zh: 就目前而言，安理会很可能会继续按其现有方式运作。

sentences.en: Whether it can adapt to the challenges of the 21st century is still an open question.
sentences.zh: 它是否能够适应21世纪的挑战仍然是一个未知数。

sentences.en: The UN Security Council is one of the most powerful parts of the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 联合国安理会是联合国最强大的部分之一。

sentences.en: It was created after World War II to protect peace, solve conflicts, and uphold international law.
sentences.zh: 它创立于二战之后，旨在维护和平、解决冲突并捍卫国际法。

sentences.en: But its structure, especially the power of the permanent members, often leads to debate and disagreement.
sentences.zh: 但它的结构，特别是常任理事国权力，常常引发辩论和分歧。

sentences.en: Some see it as a vital tool for international cooperation.
sentences.zh: 有些人认为它是国际合作不可或缺的工具。

sentences.en: Others believe it is outdated and needs urgent reform.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则认为它已经过时，急需改革。

sentences.en: What do you think? Can the Security Council change to meet the needs of today’s world or will it remain a symbol of the past?
sentences.zh: 你怎么看？安理会能否变革以满足当今世界的需要，还是它将继续成为过去的象征？
